entities.summary: Adijat Gbadamosi is a bantamweight/super bantamweight boxer and silver medalist at the 2018 Buenos Aires Youth Olympic. She is the first Nigerian female boxer to win an African boxing title after a TKO victory over Zimbabwean Patience Mastara during the 2023 Africa Super Bantamweight female title fight.
